ModMetaData.name: RimMT Path Endpoint Compatibility A1.1
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: Narrow path endpoint compatibility for FinishFrame jobs. When a construction job requests OnCell for an unwalkable frame cell, StartPath uses Touch so the pawn can work from an adjacent cell. The former per-cell glow Harmony cache is retired.
